source.title: Do Medical Foundation Models Generalize on the African Brain?
source.provenance_note: Released script defaults, not independently verified settings for every reported result. Paper says linear classifier; released code uses a BatchNorm/ReLU/dropout MLP. The file version marker is not a Git commit SHA.

task_adaptations.head: 1024 -> 128 -> 64 -> 5; BatchNorm, ReLU and dropout 0.3 after each hidden layer
task_adaptations.loss: Five-class unweighted cross-entropy replaces binary BCEWithLogitsLoss
task_adaptations.preprocessing: Existing CT RAS/percentile/prefix-cache/112-cubed crop and augmentation contract retained instead of the study's normalized 96-cubed MRI input
task_adaptations.evaluation: Existing five development folds, final-budget checkpoint per fold, development refit and separate held-out test; not the study's five random 50:50 splits
